title: Coordinate polynomial products span the Hermite family
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and, for each coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $p_i$ be a real polynomial. The product over coordinates of the polynomial $p_i$ in coordinate $i$ belongs to the real linear span of all multivariate Hermite polynomials on $\mathbb R^n$, formed as products of normalized one-variable Hermite polynomials.
hypotheses_covered: An arbitrary real polynomial is specified for each coordinate
